goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet-squat.setup: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest with both hands. Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little.
goblet-squat.move: Sit down between your knees until your thighs are about level with the floor, then stand back up.
goblet-squat.breathe: Breathe in on the way down, out as you stand.
goblet-squat.mistake: Knees caving inward or heels lifting off the floor.
goblet-squat.cue: Chest tall, knees track over your toes.

box-squat.name: Bodyweight squat to bench
box-squat.setup: Stand in front of a bench or sturdy chair, feet shoulder-width apart, arms out in front for balance.
box-squat.move: Sit back until you lightly touch the seat, don't rest, then stand up.
box-squat.breathe: In on the way down, out as you stand.
box-squat.mistake: Dropping onto the seat and relaxing.
box-squat.cue: Touch and go, like the seat is hot.

db-bench.name: Dumbbell bench press
db-bench.setup: Lie on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, feet flat on the floor.
db-bench.move: Press the weights up until your arms are straight, then lower them slowly to your chest.
db-bench.breathe: In as you lower, out as you press.
db-bench.mistake: Elbows flared straight out to the sides.
db-bench.cue: Elbows about 45 degrees from your body.

db-floor-press.name: Dumbbell floor press
db-floor-press.setup: Lie on the floor, knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand with your upper arms resting on the floor.
db-floor-press.move: Press the weights up until your arms are straight, then lower until your elbows touch the floor.
db-floor-press.breathe: In as you lower, out as you press.
db-floor-press.mistake: Bouncing your elbows off the floor.
db-floor-press.cue: Pause with elbows on the floor, then press.

pushup.name: Push-up
pushup.setup: Hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
pushup.move: Lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up.
pushup.breathe: In as you lower, out as you push.

knee-pushup.name: Knee push-up
knee-pushup.setup: Hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders, knees on the floor, body straight from head to knees.
knee-pushup.move: Lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up.
knee-pushup.breathe: In as you lower, out as you push.
knee-pushup.mistake: Bending at the hips instead of keeping a straight line.
knee-pushup.cue: Straight line from head to knees.

db-row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
db-row.setup: One hand and one knee on a bench (or a sturdy chair), back flat, dumbbell hanging in the free hand.
db-row.move: Pull the weight up to your hip, pause, then lower it slowly. Do all reps on one side, then switch.
db-row.breathe: Out as you pull, in as you lower.
db-row.mistake: Twisting your body to swing the weight up.
db-row.cue: Pull your elbow towards your back pocket.

band-row.name: Band row
band-row.setup: Loop a band around a post at chest height, hold both ends, step back until it's tight.
band-row.move: Pull your hands to your ribs, squeeze your shoulder blades, then let the band back slowly.
band-row.breathe: Out as you pull, in as you return.
band-row.mistake: Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears.

backpack-row.name: Backpack row
backpack-row.setup: Fill a backpack with books. Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, holding the bag by the straps.
backpack-row.move: Pull the bag towards your belly, pause, lower slowly.
backpack-row.breathe: Out as you pull, in as you lower.
backpack-row.cue: Flat back, pull with your elbows.

db-ohp.name: Dumbbell overhead press
db-ohp.setup: Stand or sit tall, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
db-ohp.move: Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight, then lower to your shoulders.
db-ohp.breathe: Out as you press, in as you lower.
db-ohp.mistake: Leaning back and arching your lower back.

pike-pushup.name: Pike push-up
pike-pushup.setup: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in so your hips point up like an upside-down V.
pike-pushup.move: Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor, then push back up.
pike-pushup.breathe: In as you lower, out as you push.
pike-pushup.mistake: Letting the hips drop so it turns into a normal push-up.
pike-pushup.cue: Hips high, head moves between your hands.

plank.name: Plank
plank.setup: Forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders, legs straight behind you.
plank.move: Hold a straight line from head to heels.
plank.breathe: Slow, steady breaths. Don't hold your breath.

knee-plank.name: Knee plank
knee-plank.setup: Forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders, knees on the floor.
knee-plank.move: Hold a straight line from head to knees.

db-rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
db-rdl.setup: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
db-rdl.move: Push your hips back and slide the weights down your legs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then stand tall.
db-rdl.breathe: In as you lower, out as you stand.
db-rdl.mistake: Rounding your back to reach lower.
db-rdl.cue: Hips back, like closing a car door with your bum.

glute-bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute-bridge.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor close to your bum.
glute-bridge.move: Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, pause, lower.
glute-bridge.breathe: Out as you lift, in as you lower.
glute-bridge.mistake: Arching your lower back instead of squeezing your glutes.
glute-bridge.cue: Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.

incline-pushup.name: Incline push-up
incline-pushup.setup: Hands on a bench or sturdy table, body in a straight line, feet on the floor.
incline-pushup.move: Lower your chest to the edge, then push away.
incline-pushup.breathe: In as you lower, out as you push.

incline-db-press.name: Incline dumbbell press
incline-db-press.setup: Set the bench to a low incline. Sit back with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
incline-db-press.move: Press up and slightly back until your arms are straight, then lower slowly.
incline-db-press.breathe: In as you lower, out as you press.
incline-db-press.mistake: Setting the bench too steep, which turns it into a shoulder press.

lat-pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
lat-pulldown.setup: Sit with your thighs under the pad, grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
lat-pulldown.move: Pull the bar to your upper chest, then let it rise slowly.
lat-pulldown.breathe: Out as you pull, in as it rises.
lat-pulldown.mistake: Leaning far back and yanking the bar.
lat-pulldown.cue: Pull your elbows down to your sides.

band-pulldown.name: Band pulldown
band-pulldown.setup: Anchor a band high (over a door or a bar). Kneel and hold the ends with straight arms above you.
band-pulldown.move: Pull your elbows down to your sides, pause, let your arms go back up slowly.
band-pulldown.breathe: Out as you pull, in as you return.
band-pulldown.mistake: Pulling with your hands instead of your elbows.

db-pullover.name: Dumbbell pullover
db-pullover.setup: Lie on the bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest, arms slightly bent.
db-pullover.move: Lower the weight back behind your head until you feel a stretch, then pull it back over your chest.
db-pullover.breathe: In as you lower, out as you pull back.
db-pullover.mistake: Bending your elbows more and more so it becomes a triceps move.
db-pullover.cue: Arms stay in the same slight bend.

db-curl.name: Dumbbell curl
db-curl.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
db-curl.move: Curl the weights up without swinging, then lower them slowly.
db-curl.breathe: Out as you curl, in as you lower.
db-curl.mistake: Swinging your body to lift the weight.
db-curl.cue: Elbows stay pinned to your sides.

hammer-curl.name: Hammer curl
hammer-curl.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
hammer-curl.move: Curl the weights up keeping your palms facing in, then lower slowly.
hammer-curl.breathe: Out as you curl, in as you lower.
hammer-curl.mistake: Swinging or letting the elbows drift forward.

band-curl.name: Band curl
band-curl.setup: Stand on the middle of a band, hold an end in each hand, palms forward.
band-curl.move: Curl your hands up to your shoulders, then lower slowly.
band-curl.breathe: Out as you curl, in as you lower.
band-curl.mistake: Letting the band snap your arms down.

dead-bug.name: Dead bug
dead-bug.setup: Lie on your back, arms pointing at the ceiling, knees bent over your hips.
dead-bug.move: Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg towards the floor, return, then switch sides. Count reps per side.
dead-bug.breathe: Out as you extend, in as you return.
dead-bug.mistake: Lower back lifting off the floor.
dead-bug.cue: Press your lower back into the floor.

bird-dog.name: Bird dog
bird-dog.setup: On hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat.
bird-dog.move: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, hold a second, return, switch sides. Count reps per side.
bird-dog.breathe: Out as you reach, in as you return.
bird-dog.mistake: Twisting your hips as the leg goes back.
bird-dog.cue: Keep a cup of water balanced on your back.

split-squat.name: Dumbbell split squat
split-squat.setup: One foot forward, one foot back, about a stride apart, dumbbells at your sides.
split-squat.move: Lower your back knee towards the floor, then drive up through your front foot. Do all reps on one side, then switch.
split-squat.breathe: In on the way down, out on the way up.
split-squat.cue: Torso upright, straight down and up.

bw-split-squat.name: Bodyweight split squat
bw-split-squat.setup: One foot forward, one foot back, about a stride apart, hands on your hips.
bw-split-squat.move: Lower your back knee towards the floor, then drive up. Do all reps on one side, then switch.

calf-raise.name: Calf raise
calf-raise.setup: Stand on the edge of a step or on flat ground, holding something for balance.
calf-raise.move: Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.
calf-raise.breathe: Out as you rise, in as you lower.
calf-raise.cue: Pause for a second at the top.

single-calf-raise.name: Single-leg calf raise
single-calf-raise.setup: Stand on one foot on a step edge, holding a wall or rail for balance.
single-calf-raise.move: Rise onto your toes, pause, lower slowly. Do all reps on one side, then switch.
single-calf-raise.breathe: Out as you rise, in as you lower.

lateral-raise.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
lateral-raise.setup: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides, elbows slightly bent.
lateral-raise.move: Raise your arms out to the sides until they're level with your shoulders, then lower slowly.
lateral-raise.breathe: Out as you raise, in as you lower.
lateral-raise.cue: Lead with your elbows, pour the jug at the top.

band-lateral-raise.name: Band lateral raise
band-lateral-raise.setup: Stand on the middle of a band, an end in each hand at your sides.
band-lateral-raise.move: Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, lower slowly.
band-lateral-raise.breathe: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

db-overhead-extension.name: Overhead triceps extension
db-overhead-extension.setup: Sit or stand tall holding one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
db-overhead-extension.move: Bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head, then straighten your arms.
db-overhead-extension.breathe: In as you lower, out as you straighten.

bench-dip.name: Bench dip
bench-dip.setup: Hands on the edge of a bench or sturdy chair behind you, legs bent, feet on the floor.
bench-dip.move: Bend your elbows to lower your body a little, then push back up.
bench-dip.breathe: In as you lower, out as you push.
bench-dip.mistake: Dropping too low, which strains the shoulders.
bench-dip.cue: Go down only until your elbows reach 90 degrees.

rear-delt-fly.name: Rear delt fly
rear-delt-fly.setup: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, light dumbbells hanging under your chest.
rear-delt-fly.move: Raise your arms out to the sides, squeeze your shoulder blades, lower slowly.
rear-delt-fly.breathe: Out as you raise, in as you lower.
rear-delt-fly.mistake: Using momentum to swing the weights.
rear-delt-fly.cue: Slow and light, squeeze at the top.

prone-y-raise.name: Prone Y raise
prone-y-raise.setup: Lie face down on the floor, arms stretched overhead in a Y shape, thumbs up.
prone-y-raise.move: Lift your arms off the floor, pause, lower slowly.
prone-y-raise.breathe: Out as you lift, in as you lower.
prone-y-raise.mistake: Lifting your head and arching your neck.
prone-y-raise.cue: Look at the floor, lift with your upper back.

leg-press.name: Leg press machine
leg-press.setup: Sit in the machine with your back flat on the pad. Feet shoulder-width apart, in the middle of the platform.
leg-press.move: Lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees, then press it away without locking your knees.
leg-press.breathe: In as you lower, out as you press.
leg-press.mistake: Hips lifting off the seat or knees caving in.
leg-press.cue: Push through your whole foot, knees soft at the top.

machine-chest-press.name: Chest press machine
machine-chest-press.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest. Back flat on the pad, feet on the floor.
machine-chest-press.move: Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight, then return slowly.
machine-chest-press.breathe: Out as you press, in as you return.
machine-chest-press.mistake: Shoulders rolling forward at the end of the press.
machine-chest-press.cue: Shoulder blades back and down, press smooth.

machine-shoulder-press.name: Shoulder press machine
machine-shoulder-press.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles start level with your shoulders. Back against the pad.
machine-shoulder-press.move: Press the handles overhead until your arms are nearly straight, then lower slowly.
machine-shoulder-press.breathe: Out as you press, in as you lower.
machine-shoulder-press.mistake: Arching your lower back to push the weight up.

cable-row.name: Seated cable row
cable-row.setup: Sit with feet on the footplates, knees slightly bent. Hold the handle with arms straight and back tall.
cable-row.move: Pull the handle to your belly, squeeze your shoulder blades, then let your arms straighten slowly.
cable-row.breathe: Out as you pull, in as you return.
cable-row.mistake: Leaning back and swinging the weight.
cable-row.cue: Chest tall, pull your elbows back.

leg-curl.name: Leg curl machine
leg-curl.setup: Adjust the pad so it sits just above your heels and the pivot lines up with your knees.
leg-curl.move: Curl your heels towards your glutes, then return slowly.
leg-curl.breathe: Out as you curl, in as you return.
leg-curl.mistake: Lifting your hips off the pad.

leg-extension.name: Leg extension machine
leg-extension.setup: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the pivot and the pad rests on your lower shins.
leg-extension.move: Straighten your legs until they are nearly level, pause, then lower slowly.
leg-extension.breathe: Out as you lift, in as you lower.
leg-extension.mistake: Swinging the weight up with momentum.
leg-extension.cue: Pause for one second at the top.

pec-deck.name: Pec deck machine (chest fly)
pec-deck.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height. Back flat on the pad, elbows slightly bent.
pec-deck.move: Bring the handles together in front of you, then open back out slowly until you feel a stretch.
pec-deck.breathe: Out as you squeeze, in as you open.
pec-deck.mistake: Opening too far and straining the front of the shoulders.
pec-deck.cue: Hug a big tree, squeeze in the middle.

hip-abduction.name: Hip abduction machine (knees out)
hip-abduction.setup: Sit with your back against the pad and the pads on the outside of your knees. Feet on the footrests.
hip-abduction.move: Push your knees out to the sides, pause, then bring them back slowly.
hip-abduction.breathe: Out as you push, in as you return.
hip-abduction.mistake: Rocking your body to move the weight.
hip-abduction.cue: Sit tall, move only your legs.

hip-adduction.name: Hip adduction machine (knees in)
hip-adduction.setup: Sit with your back against the pad and the pads on the inside of your knees. Start with legs open to a comfortable width.
hip-adduction.move: Squeeze your knees together, pause, then open slowly.
hip-adduction.breathe: Out as you squeeze, in as you open.
hip-adduction.mistake: Opening your legs too wide at the start.

machine-calf-raise.name: Calf raise machine
machine-calf-raise.setup: Set the pad on your shoulders or thighs, balls of your feet on the platform, heels hanging off.
machine-calf-raise.move: Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower your heels below the platform.
machine-calf-raise.breathe: Out as you rise, in as you lower.
machine-calf-raise.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

face-pull.name: Cable face pull
face-pull.setup: Set the cable at about face height with a rope. Hold the ends, step back, arms straight.
face-pull.move: Pull the rope towards your face, elbows high and out, then return slowly.
face-pull.breathe: Out as you pull, in as you return.
face-pull.mistake: Using too much weight and leaning back.

triceps-pushdown.name: Cable triceps pushdown
triceps-pushdown.setup: Stand facing a high cable with a bar or rope. Elbows tucked at your sides.
triceps-pushdown.move: Push down until your arms are straight, then let your hands rise to chest height.
triceps-pushdown.breathe: Out as you push, in as you return.
triceps-pushdown.mistake: Elbows drifting forward or flaring out.
triceps-pushdown.cue: Elbows stay glued to your sides.

cable-curl.name: Cable biceps curl
cable-curl.setup: Stand facing a low cable with a straight or curved bar. Elbows at your sides.
cable-curl.move: Curl the bar up to your shoulders, then lower slowly.
cable-curl.breathe: Out as you curl, in as you lower.
cable-curl.mistake: Swinging your body to lift the bar.

cable-crunch.name: Cable crunch
cable-crunch.setup: Kneel facing a high cable with a rope held by your forehead. Hips stay still.
cable-crunch.move: Curl your ribs towards your hips, round your upper back, then return slowly.
cable-crunch.breathe: Out as you crunch, in as you return.
cable-crunch.mistake: Pulling with your arms or sitting back on your heels.
cable-crunch.cue: Curl the spine, hips stay still.

barbell-squat.name: Barbell back squat
barbell-squat.setup: Set the bar at upper chest height in the rack. Bar across your upper back, feet shoulder-width, then step back.
barbell-squat.move: Sit down until your thighs are about level with the floor, then stand up.
barbell-squat.breathe: Breathe in and brace before you go down, out as you stand.
barbell-squat.mistake: Knees caving in or your chest dropping forward.
barbell-squat.cue: Start with the empty bar. Chest tall, knees over toes.

barbell-rdl.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
barbell-rdl.setup: Stand holding the bar at your thighs, feet hip-width, knees slightly bent.
barbell-rdl.move: Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs until you feel a stretch, then stand tall.
barbell-rdl.breathe: In as you lower, out as you stand.
barbell-rdl.cue: Hips back, bar close to your legs.
